Hi Rishi / Lauren,

Thanks again for the deep dive last week. Novus finished an internal run of the TCO comparison and has three asks before procurement will move to a formal POC:

- A line-item comparison of credits / migration assistance under your proposed packaging vs our incumbent (VectorGrid).
- A firm pilot conversion price (consumption rate) after the pilot window.
- Signed assurances on data handling / retention during the migration window (procurement flagged this).

I've attached our bid sheet for context (Novus_bid_sheet.xlsx). Procurement is willing to run a 90-day pilot but needs clarity on the conversion economics so they can model 12-month runrate. Can you provide a short crosswalk plus suggested concession structure?

Wanted to loop Sanjay from our partner team (cc'd) who will help validate runtime compatibility questions.

Next steps: can we get a proposed term sheet by end of day Wednesday?

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Competitive review + credit/packaging ask (Novus.ai)

Alex — thanks for the context and the sheet. We're happy to put a compact crosswalk together. Quick notes so the term sheet aligns with internal constraints:

- We can offer a dedicated pilot credit bucket plus an integration fund, but mixing credits and list discounts will change the accounting treatment for an enterprise contract.
- Proposed starter offer (ballpark): $40k pilot credit + $25k migration/integration fund; 20% off list for the first 90 days if you hit the pilot KPIs.
- For conversion pricing post-pilot we typically anchor to a consumption-rate floor (example: $0.015/token equivalent) with a sunset ramp over 60 days to your committed rate.

Would like to confirm expected pilot volume (token/month) and the success KPIs you mentioned in the deck. If procurement needs an itemized exit-assist credit (for rollback), we can include a capped line item — need to flag to finance.

I'll draft a short proposed_term_sheet.pdf and circulate later today. Lauren / Connor / Marissa — can you validate SLA uplift feasibility and any legal hooks?

— Rishi

Subject: Re: Competitive review + credit/packaging ask (Novus.ai)

Alex — appreciate the clarity. Short version from commercial/legal perspective:

- Pilot structure we can offer: 90-day pilot with 20% off list for measured consumption up to X tokens (we need your expected consumption bucket to finalize).
- Migration assistance: one-time fund (we propose $25k) + 2 technical enablement days (remote) and a migration runbook.
- Exit assistance: a capped rollback credit equal to unused portion of the migration fund + a 30% time-and-material estimate on data egress (if requested).

Inline matrix (high-level):
- Pilot credits: $40k credit applied to usage during pilot.
- Migration fund: $25k (non-recouped, one-time).
- Conversion floor: anchor at $0.015/token equivalent (negotiable with 12-mo commit).
- SLA uplift: we can offer a 60-day elevated SLO for pilot environments (requires legal/ops sign-off).

Procurement flags: itemized egress estimates and proof of audit logs are gating items. If procurement sends their questionnaire, we will assign an Evidence Owner and respond within 3 business days.

Alex — if you can share expected pilot token volumes and the procurement questionnaire now, we'll ship a clean term sheet and a short statement of work.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Dir, Commercial Contracts — Redwood Inference
